methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 camera and smartphone gimbal stabilizers spanning 2019-2025, prioritized by search volume and category breadth (DJI RS series, DJI Osmo Mobile series, Zhiyun Crane/Smooth, Hohem iSteady, Insta360 Flow 2 Pro, Moza AirCross 3). Specs were re-verified against manufacturer spec pages (dji.com, store.zhiyun-tech.com, store.hohem.com, store.gudsen.com, store.insta360.com) and corroborated with editorial coverage from Newsshooter, CineD, Digital Camera World, DPReview, Engadget, Macworld, and 9to5Toys. Weight and payload are in pounds (lbs) rounded to two decimal places; battery_hours reflects the manufacturer's rated standby/balanced figure; built_in_screen is a boolean (true = any integrated display on the gimbal body, not a phone app and not a non-display status LED/indicator); quick_release is a short string describing the system type or null if not specified; priceUsd reflects US MSRP at launch or current official store price, whichever was most recently verifiable. Adversarial pass corrected 3 fields: Zhiyun Crane 4 max payload (manufacturer does not publish a payload figure -> nulled), Insta360 Flow 2 Pro built_in_screen (it has a selfie mirror, not a screen -> false), DJI RS 3 Mini price (fabricated $199 'current' figure -> launch MSRP $369), and Zhiyun Smooth 5S battery (25 -> 24 manufacturer-rated). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: DJI RS 4
products.provenance: Verified. Weight 1,066 g / 2.35 lb, payload 3 kg / 6.6 lb, and 12-hour max runtime (balanced/stationary) confirmed on DJI spec page and via B&H Photo listing. Announced/released April 9, 2024. Price $549 USD (gimbal-only) confirmed across multiple US launch-day sources and B&H.

products.name: DJI RS 4 Pro
products.provenance: Verified. Weight 1,242 g / 2.74 lb and payload 4.5 kg / 9.9 lb confirmed on DJI spec page and B&H. Max runtime 13 hours (standard battery) confirmed via DJI and CineD. Price $869 USD (gimbal-only; combo $1,099) confirmed across multiple US launch reports and B&H. Fixed OLED touchscreen confirmed. Announced April 9, 2024.

products.name: DJI RS 3 Mini
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP $369; frequently discounted (DJI store ~$359, retailers as low as $237 in 2025)

specs.quick_release: Dual-layer QR plate with landscape/portrait switching

products.provenance: Corrected. Weight 795 g / 1.75 lb, payload 2 kg / 4.4 lb, 10-hour battery, and 1.4-inch color touchscreen confirmed on DJI spec page and Newsshooter (Jan 10, 2023 launch). Draft's claim of a $199 'current DJI Store price' could NOT be verified and appears fabricated; Newsshooter (May 2025) documents a reduction to $237 and the DJI store standard is ~$359. priceUsd set to documented launch MSRP $369 with discount range noted.

products.name: DJI Osmo Mobile 7P
products.provenance: Verified. Weight 368 g / 0.81 lb (full kit) and 10-hour battery (3,350 mAh) confirmed via DJI spec page, Newsshooter, and CineD. Max phone payload 300 g / 0.66 lb confirmed. Launch Feb 18, 2025 and MSRP $149 confirmed by CineD/Newsshooter. built_in_screen false: body has only a system-status/battery LED indicator, no display; controlled via DJI Mimo app. Ships with Multifunctional Module (tracking + fill light).

products.name: DJI Osmo Mobile 6
products.provenance: Verified. Weight ~309 g / 0.67 lb and ~6h24m battery (1,000 mAh / 7.74 Wh) confirmed on DJI spec page and TechRadar. Max phone weight 290 g / 0.64 lb confirmed. Launched late September 2022 at MSRP $139 (US). No built-in screen; controlled via DJI Mimo app.

products.name: DJI Osmo Mobile SE
products.priceNote: MSRP at launch; frequently discounted at the DJI Store
products.provenance: Verified. Weight 353 g / 0.78 lb, 8-hour battery, and max phone payload 290 g / 0.64 lb confirmed on DJI spec page and DIYP/360TechGuide. Launch Feb 15, 2023 and MSRP $109 confirmed by 9to5Toys. No built-in screen; controlled via DJI Mimo app. (Specific '$55 current' figure not independently confirmed; removed from priceNote.)

products.name: Zhiyun Crane 4
products.provenance: Corrected. Price $669 (standard) / $749 (combo) confirmed on Zhiyun store and CineD. Weight 1,673 g / 3.69 lb confirmed (Videomaker, MakeUseOf, CineD). Battery 12 hours via four 18650 cells confirmed (Newsshooter, CineD). 1.22-inch color touchscreen confirmed. max_payload_lb NULLED: the draft's 9.9 lb (4.5 kg) is unsupported and matches the RS 4 Pro figure (likely copy error); CineD explicitly states 'ZHIYUN does not specify a maximum payload' for the Crane 4. Some retailers cite 13.2 lb / 5.98 kg but that is not manufacturer-published, so null beats a guess. Released July 2023.

products.name: Zhiyun Smooth 5S
products.provenance: Corrected. Launch Nov 8, 2022 and standard MSRP $169 confirmed by Digital Camera World ('$169/£169... or Combo at $219'). Weight 625 g / 1.38 lb confirmed across reviews. Max phone payload 300 g / 0.66 lb confirmed. battery_hours corrected 25 -> 24: manufacturer/editorial rating is 'up to 24 hours' (2,600 mAh, 15W PD) per MakeUseOf and Pocket-lint. Has a rear mode/status indicator panel, not a full display screen; built_in_screen false.

products.name: Hohem iSteady M7
products.provenance: Verified. Launch Dec 10, 2024 and MSRP $299 confirmed via Hohem PR Newswire release and B&H. Weight 629 g / 1.39 lb and max payload 500 g / 1.1 lb confirmed on Hohem store and ProVideo Coalition review. Battery 12 hours balanced (3,200 mAh); ~8 hours with AI tracking active per PR/review. built_in_screen true refers to the detachable touchscreen remote that ships in the box (used for preview/target selection). Corroboration URL replaced with the manufacturer's PR Newswire announcement (DCW review URL was not stably resolvable).

products.name: Hohem iSteady Mobile Plus
products.priceNote: Regular price on Hohem store; frequently on sale at $59
products.provenance: Verified. Live Hohem store page shows regular $99 / sale $59. Weight 489.7 g / 1.08 lb (incl. battery) and max payload 280 g / 0.62 lb confirmed on store page and Android Authority review. Battery up to 12 hours (1,800 mAh). Original product released 2019. No built-in screen confirmed.

products.name: Insta360 Flow 2 Pro
products.provenance: Corrected. Price $159.99 (Standard Bundle) / $189.99 (Creator Bundle) and release Jan 16, 2025 confirmed by Insta360, Newsshooter, and Camera Jabber. Weight 357 g / 0.79 lb and max phone payload 330 g / 0.73 lb confirmed. Battery 10 hours (1,100 mAh) confirmed. built_in_screen corrected true -> FALSE: the Flow 2 Pro has a selfie MIRROR, not a display/OLED screen; confirmed by Digital Camera World, Engadget, and Macworld reviews. The draft's 'OLED smart display on gimbal body' was fabricated.

products.name: Moza AirCross 3
products.provenance: Verified. Price $469 (standard) and payload 3.2 kg / 7.05 lb confirmed on Gudsen store and First Quadcopter review. Weight 1.3 kg gimbal-only / ~1.5 kg with tripod (2.87 lb with tripod) confirmed. Battery up to 20 hours (3,500 mAh) and Manfrotto-compatible QR plate confirmed by First Quadcopter. 2x4cm mono-LCD confirmed as built-in screen. Announced Nov 11-12, 2021; availability/shipping and review coverage December 2021 (release kept as 2021-12). Draft's dead Camera Jabber corroboration link was not used; First Quadcopter review retained as a live corroboration.
